messages.subject: tidyLPA example
parts:
Dear Joshua,

I am interested in running LPA and came across your tidyLPA approach. The explanation and steps are very clearly explained on your GitHub website (thanks!). 

I have run through your example, and got stuck while reading through the compare_solutions paragraph. You suggest that model 1 with 4 profiles has the lowest BIC, but Im not sure you how derive this? Wouldn’t 1 profile be the optimum for this dataset? Or 4 if you go for model 2? I was hoping you could explain why you picked 4 profiles?

Many thanks in advance,
With best wishes,
Thomas
